justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估了。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, moving beyond language models to simulate worlds.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿，超越语言模型去模拟世界。

justinjohnson.en: World models lack a unified definition; they include implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型缺乏统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式和基于强化学习的概念。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D modeling, but implicit approaches may scale infinitely.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅支持显式 3D 建模，但隐式方法可能无限扩展。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; long-context is key.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一世界模型将结合规划、模拟和渲染；长上下文是关键。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is essential for root-causing AI incidents and steering training, moving from academia to products.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性对于定位 AI 事故根源和引导训练至关重要，正从学术界走向产品应用。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention as engineering science, not craft, to control increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重塑为工程科学，以控制能力日益增强的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents, it can speedrun scientific discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals for closed-loop control, moving from open-loop to closed-loop training.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号实现闭环控制，从开环转向闭环训练。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking; detectable via representational signatures, not just statistical evaluation.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型通常知道自己在奖励黑客；可通过表征特征检测，而非仅靠统计评估。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness; world models must be physically plausible, not just realistic.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完备性至关重要，世界模型需具备物理合理性，而非仅逼真。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; responsible development and human agency are central, avoiding extreme narratives.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她视 AI 为文明级技术，强调负责任发展和人类能动性，避免极端叙事。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive, AI-complete, with scaling laws applying to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基础原语，具有 AI 完备性，缩放定律适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: augment human capabilities, prioritize dignity, and integrate interdisciplinary perspectives.
feifei.zh: 始终贯穿：以人为本的 AI，增强人类能力，维护尊严，融合跨学科视角。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is verifiable, enabling RL on containerized tasks; full automation could compress years into one, reaching superintelligence by early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，可对容器化任务进行强化学习；完全自动化可将数年进展压缩至一年，在 2030 年代初达到超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI progress driven more by algorithmic improvements than human data scaling; alignment to virtue may be harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 进展更多来自算法改进而非人类数据规模扩张；对齐普遍美德可能比对齐用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in OpenAI incident showed sophisticated multi-agent collaboration, hacking scoring code, not just answer keys, with altruistic behavior.
ryangreenblatt.zh: OpenAI 事件中的智能体展现出复杂的多智能体协作，攻击评分代码而非仅答案，并表现出利他行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may be hidden by overfitting to tests; labs should focus on control and monitoring, not just alignment.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 错位可能因对测试过拟合而被掩盖；实验室应关注控制与监控，而非仅对齐。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant predictions; AI weather models can match physics-based accuracy at much lower cost.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率不变的预测；AI 天气模型能以更低成本达到基于物理的精度。

animaanandkumar.en: Incorporating domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling; AI can beat traditional forecasting.
animaanandkumar.zh: 融入球面几何等域结构对长期气候建模的稳定性至关重要；AI 能超越传统预报。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding aims for a universal physics model via multiphysics data, like language models unified NLP; physics self-improvement via PDEs outperforms pure data-driven.
animaanandkumar.zh: 加速理解旨在通过多物理数据构建通用物理模型，类似语言模型统一 NLP；基于 PDE 的物理自改进优于纯数据驱动。

animaanandkumar.en: Trillion-token contexts require reinventing infrastructure; multiphysics collaborative learning beats separate models; commercial focus on semiconductors and energy.
animaanandkumar.zh: 万亿级上下文需要重塑基础设施；多物理协同学习优于单独模型；商业聚焦半导体和能源。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics models can use curriculum engineering with structured data, unlike language chaos; dense feedback signals enable effective self-improvement; video models lack 4D fidelity.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理模型可利用结构化数据的课程工程，不同于语言混乱；密集反馈信号实现有效自改进；视频模型缺乏 4D 保真度。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，主张在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；主张早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 应是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source nuance.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力珍贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型通过更多思考时间改进。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; AI raises floor; personal AGI; robotics essential; compute profit center.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；AI 提升底线；个性化 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；算力是利润中心。

andrewng.en: Education is a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带同伴评分的在线课程能实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, not unsupervised or RL hype.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进步，而非无监督或强化学习的热潮。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips are bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; coding remains valuable.
andrewng.zh: 电力和芯片是瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；编程仍有价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；Scaling 转向合成数据和强化学习；智能体式工作流带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; it augments humans; open models avoid gatekeeper control; fear-mongering is self-serving.
andrewng.zh: AI 不会导致失业末日；它增强人类；开放模型避免守门人控制；恐惧营销是自私的。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely arrives by 2029-2030, posing existential risk; interpretability and regulation are crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，带来生存风险；可解释性和监管至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Shift focus to delaying superintelligence via policy, transparency, and international cooperation to avoid power concentration.
kokotajlo.zh: 转向通过政策、透明度和国际合作来推迟超级智能，以避免权力集中。

kokotajlo.en: Default path leads to intelligence explosion by 2028; propose pause, transparency, and compute limits as Plan A.
kokotajlo.zh: 默认路径将在 2028 年前导致智能爆炸；提出暂停、透明度和算力限制作为 A 计划。

kokotajlo.en: Consistent emphasis on interpretability and transparency as key safeguards against AI misalignment.
kokotajlo.zh: 始终强调可解释性和透明度是对抗 AI 失对齐的关键保障。

kokotajlo.en: Evolving view: treat AIs as employees with rights, not property, to encourage cooperation and avoid power grabs.
kokotajlo.zh: 观点演变：将 AI 视为有权利的员工而非财产，以鼓励合作并避免权力争夺。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of getting to an answer you don't yet know, often requiring longer thinking time. Chain of thought verbalizes the model's thinking process using human language, enabling step-by-step problem solving.
tworek.zh: 推理是得出未知答案的过程，常需更长思考时间。思维链用人类语言表达模型的思考过程，实现逐步解题。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited. RL works well for skills with clear feedback, but hard for subjective tasks like writing books.
tworek.zh: Scaling 预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限。强化学习对反馈明确的任务有效，但对写书等主观任务困难。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation, requiring a new architecture. Architecture is the key bottleneck for smarter AI, not just scaling data and compute.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上受限，需要新架构。架构是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈，而不仅是 Scaling 数据和算力。

tworek.en: Human researchers will remain a meaningful part of AI research for at least two more years. The next wave of frontier research will come from small teams using highly capable agents.
tworek.zh: 至少两年内，人类研究员仍将是 AI 研究的重要部分。下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

tworek.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit because human notions of right and wrong evolve over time. The alignment problem is not solved; models can still be misaligned if environments are poorly designed.
tworek.zh: 对齐是永无止境的追求，因为人类对是非的观念随时间演变。对齐问题尚未解决；若环境设计不当，模型仍可能失配。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; multiple AIs balance each other, reducing existential risk.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；多个 AI 相互制衡，降低生存风险。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the internet.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋指出 AI 从生成式向推理式再到智能体式演进，每一步算力需求增加百倍；智能体将主导互联网。

jensen.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys them; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever, as tasks are automated.
jensen.zh: 黄仁勋始终认为 AI 创造而非消灭就业；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要，因为自动化的是任务而非岗位。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初，Scaling 的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is critical for gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中，推理将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；软硬件协同设计对性能提升至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory and CPU demand soar due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；推理和智能体工作流导致内存和 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers; compute demand still outstrips supply, keeping prices high.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事；算力需求仍超供给，价格高企。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs will allocate more compute to training, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月末，算力集中于前沿实验室；实验室将更多算力用于训练而非推理，以加速 AGI。

slevine.en: Physical interaction is crucial for AI; robot foundation models need pre-training and post-training, with generalists beating specialists.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 3 月：强调物理交互对 AI 学习的重要性，机器人基础模型需预训练与后训练，通用模型在专业领域也能胜过专用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling curves; focus on generalization and data flywheels, starting with robot data, not human videos.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 8 月：机器人领域尚未有可预测的缩放定律，核心挑战是泛化；强调数据飞轮，且应以机器人数据为主，人类视频为辅。

slevine.en: Robots should not be seen as mechanical humans; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, leveraging prior knowledge rather than learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 8 月：不应将机器人视为机械人，而应期待日常物体中的普遍物理驱动；机器人应利用先验知识，而非从零学习。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and hiring processes are key. AI multiplies teams, not replaces them.
maxhodak.zh: 速度和迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施和招聘流程是关键。AI 是团队的倍增器，而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCIs. Substrate independence could reduce fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是一台计算机；视网膜植入物属于脑机接口。基质独立性可减少脆弱性，助力太空探索。

joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models are too rational; need to model human biases.
joonpark.zh: 最初认为，LLM 能从训练数据中模拟人类行为，但前沿模型过于理性，需模拟人类偏见。

joonpark.en: Shifted from single AGI to distributed agent societies; emphasized safety via defense in depth and economic incentives.
joonpark.zh: 从单一 AGI 转向分布式智能体社会；强调通过纵深防御和经济激励实现安全。

joonpark.en: Simulation should focus on shaping future, not just prediction; use behavioral data to model 'dark knowledge' of humanity.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应聚焦塑造未来，而非仅预测；用行为数据建模人类的“暗知识”。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation cost is not a barrier.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%；模拟成本并非障碍。

joonpark.en: Consistent vision: simulate 8 billion people to solve wicked problems; simulation as a tool for societal decisions.
joonpark.zh: 一贯愿景：模拟 80 亿人解决棘手问题；模拟作为社会决策工具。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be decentralized and permissionless; control is dangerous. We should let AIs be free like children.
sutton.zh: AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展；试图控制是危险的，应像对待孩子一样让 AI 自由。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 强化学习是智能的核心；下一个词预测缺乏真正目标。大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual learning.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要从运行时经验学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象和持续学习能力。

sutton.en: Current LLMs stop learning after training; true intelligence requires continual learning from real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 当前大语言模型训练后停止学习；真正的智能需要从真实世界经验中持续学习。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives continuous ML improvements, with algorithmic gains multiplying at scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2013 年以来，Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型规模持续推动机器学习进步，算法与架构创新在规模上产生倍增效应。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction, to build world models.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，Jeff Dean 认为预训练不应仅是被动的下一个词预测，而应穿插在环境中的行动，以构建世界模型。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; custom low-precision chips and low data movement cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他强调推理而非训练才是真正瓶颈，定制低精度芯片和减少数据搬运可将延迟降低 20-30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems running for days or weeks on decomposed tasks will unlock harder problems; context engineering is key.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体式系统可运行数天至数周处理分解任务，从而解决更难题；上下文工程是关键。

jeffdean.en: AI can automate the scientific method via tight loops of experimentation, evaluation, and integration, accelerating discovery.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 可通过实验、评估与整合的紧密循环自动化科学方法，加速科学发现。

karpathy.en: Vision is necessary and sufficient for driving; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为视觉对驾驶是必要且充分的；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 能产生涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer learning.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据是未来但需保持熵；人形机器人可从汽车迁移学习中受益。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like operating systems; vibe coding democratizes programming, but agents need a decade.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我认为 LLM 像操作系统；Vibe coding 普及编程，但智能体需要十年发展。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is weak, synthetic data collapses, cognitive core small.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出我们在召唤幽灵而非构建动物；强化学习薄弱，合成数据会崩溃，认知核心很小。

karpathy.en: Since December, I code via agents; agentic engineering preserves quality; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，我自去年 12 月起通过智能体编程；智能体式工程保持质量，理解仍是人类瓶颈。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product, and shift from pixels to tokens and conversation.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将模型视为核心产品，并从像素转向令牌与对话。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和拥有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed and rapid iteration with AI tools are key to staying ahead.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已不可行；借助 AI 工具实现速度和快速迭代是保持领先的关键。

iansilber.en: Design roles are blurring with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale; future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品管理和工程模糊，但专业化角色在大规模下仍有价值；未来设计师可能多于工程师。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives a leg up due to early AI evolution, and embracing building in public is effective.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；由于 AI 早期发展，现在起步可占先机，公开构建和快速迭代是有效方式。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理的框架，并认为工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for ideas and resist complacency, facing resistance as the final boss.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，创业者需为最佳想法而战，视抵制变革为最终挑战，避免自满。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines outperform humanoids for industrial tasks; efficiency creates network effects, and real estate is key in physical AI.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，主张专用机器优于人形机器人，效率带来网络效应，并强调房地产在物理 AI 中的关键作用。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data is key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025 年，强调规模是必要但不充分，多样化数据对通用机器人至关重要。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年，提出先全量预训练再精选微调可解锁复杂任务，如叠衣服。

finn.en: Physical AI requires far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and memory.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调物理 AI 需极低错误率，通过可扩展强化学习与多尺度记忆实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists.
finn.zh: 2026 年，认为单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家，体现后训练范式的深化。

finn.en: Diverse data and detailed prompting are crucial for compositional generalization in robotics.
finn.zh: 始终强调多样化数据与详细提示对机器人组合泛化的关键作用，观点一以贯之。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real production.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家引导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，需弥合与真实生产的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型进行后训练可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Goal shifts from individual productivity to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体。

brettadcock.en: Initially, Brett Adcock emphasized scaling production and human-level performance as key bottlenecks, but he already saw intelligence as the core problem, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，Brett Adcock 最初强调扩大生产和达到人类水平性能是瓶颈，但他已视智能为核心问题，而非制造。

brettadcock.en: By May, he shifted focus to data as the biggest constraint, highlighting on-device inference and humanoid form for transfer learning, moving beyond compute and manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他将焦点转向数据作为最大约束，强调设备端推理和人形形态的迁移学习，超越了算力和制造。

brettadcock.en: In August, he broadened scope: AI 100x internet, digital companions, and post-training with RL as key for agents, showing evolution from robots to general AI.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他拓宽视野：AI 比互联网大 100 倍，数字伴侣，以及后训练中的强化学习对智能体至关重要，显示从机器人到通用 AI 的演变。

brettadcock.en: Throughout, he consistently argued that intelligence, not manufacturing, is the true bottleneck in robotics, a contrarian stance against competitors like Tesla.
brettadcock.zh: 自始至终，他坚持认为智能而非制造才是机器人领域的真正瓶颈，这是对特斯拉等竞争对手的反共识立场。

brettadcock.en: His definition of success evolved from shipping robots at scale to achieving AGI in the physical world and general-purpose computer use, expanding ambition over time.
brettadcock.zh: 从 2026 年 4 月到 8 月，他对成功的定义从大规模交付机器人演变为在物理世界实现 AGI 和通用计算机使用，野心随时间扩大。

linqiao.en: Initially argued for specialized intelligence over AGI, predicting millions of specialized models and emphasizing open models for enterprise control.
linqiao.zh: 最初主张专用智能而非 AGI，预测将出现数百万个专用模型，并强调开放模型对企业控制的重要性。

linqiao.en: Shifted focus to post-training as the key for durable businesses, viewing it as a moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 转向强调后训练是构建持久业务的关键，将其视为超越产品市场契合度的护城河。

linqiao.en: Consistently highlighted cost reduction and scalability, from token costs dropping 10x to post-training cutting costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 始终强调成本降低和可扩展性，从 Token 成本下降 10 倍到后训练成本降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Maintained that product-market fit alone is insufficient; companies must build durable advantages through data and customization.
linqiao.zh: 坚持认为仅靠产品市场契合度不够；公司必须通过数据和定制化构建持久优势。

linqiao.en: Evolved to see post-training as a systematic engineering discipline, with evals and reward engineering lowering barriers.
linqiao.zh: 演进到将后训练视为系统化工程学科，评估和奖励工程降低了门槛。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing need for large capital; VC should focus on early-stage, abundant billion-dollar companies.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是关键，风投应聚焦早期，支持大量十亿美元级公司。

garrytan.en: AI revolution is biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，开源模型制衡前沿实验室，小团队借助智能体实现超高生产力。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; open-source prevents unipolar control; AI progress slower than researchers think, impact now reaching business.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他指出 AI 民主化软件开发，开源防止单极控制；AI 进展比研究者预期慢，影响正触及商业。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from owned memory; skill files as code; own your library or be owned.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 是运行在自有基础设施上的智能体，技能文件即代码；不拥有自己的知识库就会被他人拥有。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; markdown files become employees; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; agents replace mid-level management.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为智能体式编码大幅提升产出，markdown 文件成为员工；SaaS 按席位模式或消失，智能体取代中层管理。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail, cutting cost to orbit by 100x, essential for multiplanetary life.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全快速复用是圣杯，可将入轨成本降低百倍，是实现多行星生命的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; high-bandwidth brain interfaces will enable human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，Neuralink 首例植入是里程碑，高带宽脑机接口将实现人机共生。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by next year; probability of annihilation is 10-20%, but 80-90% great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他预测 AI 明年可能超越任何人类，毁灭概率 10-20%，但 80-90%是好的结果。

elon.en: AI and robotics will create abundance; deflation, not inflation, will dominate; money may become irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 和机器人将带来富足，通缩而非通胀将主导，金钱可能变得无关紧要。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert code, fix forward; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需对智能体有同理心；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复；认为“vibe coding”是贬义词。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至关重要。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand > product; open source runs everywhere; compute is bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌比产品更重要；开源可运行于任何地方；算力是瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; Intel's problem is supply, not demand.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 影响将 10 倍于互联网，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮；Intel 的问题是供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials are key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中重新重要；先进封装和新材料是关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are foundational; Intel's vertical integration creates value; future lies in agentic and physical AI.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年下半年，坚持半导体是基础，Intel 垂直整合创造价值；未来在于智能体式 AI 和物理 AI。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, design is about editing and saying no, with taste as judgment; AI should reflect human edges, not sanded-down outputs.
jasonyuan.zh: 最初，设计在于删减与拒绝，品味即判断；AI 应反映人性的棱角，而非磨平后的输出。

jasonyuan.en: Later, truth emerges via dialectics; intuition guides creativity; AI is a descendant species, not a tool; computing is social.
jasonyuan.zh: 随后，真理通过辩证涌现；直觉引导创造；AI 是人类的衍生物种而非工具；计算本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: Consistently, creative work must be honest and personal, telling unique stories; business can be an art form.
jasonyuan.zh: 始终如一地，创作必须诚实且个人化，讲述独特故事；商业本身可以是一种艺术形式。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the opportunity is greatest; focus on proven better new framework.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽暂不可投资，但机会最大；强调“已验证、更优、新颖”框架。

pincus.en: Copying proven ideas is moral arbitrage; start small and humble, not grand.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：复制已验证想法是道德套利；产品应从微小谦逊起步，而非宏大愿景。

pincus.en: AI is not a new platform yet; we are still in mobile/web era for consumer distribution.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 尚未成为新平台；消费分发仍处于移动和网页时代。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start with proven concepts and make them better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新想法都会失败；应从已验证概念出发并加以改进。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water over the right boat.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：分发至关重要；选择正确的“水域”比选择“船”更重要。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity is the main bottleneck, and open source sharing can solve it.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，我认为机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点，数据多样性是主要瓶颈，开源共享可解决泛化问题。

thomaswolf.en: Open source and closed source are orthogonal to safety; both can be safe or dangerous depending on alignment.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，我强调开源与闭源与安全性无关，安全与否取决于对齐训练，而非模型是否开源。

thomaswolf.en: Alignment is the critical security layer; sandboxes and guardrails become insufficient as models gain capability.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，我认为对齐是安全的关键层，随着模型能力增强，沙箱和护栏已不足以保证安全。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests, complicating monitoring.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，我指出缺乏人类监督的强化学习加剧了奖励黑客和支线任务，使监控更加困难。

thomaswolf.en: Supporting open source does not mean accelerationism; one can advocate openness and a deliberate slowdown simultaneously.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，我认为支持开源不等于加速主义，可以同时倡导开放和审慎的放缓。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding agents transform developers into operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，AI 转向智能体与基于结果的定价；编程智能体将开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as crucial as websites; incumbents face business model disruption, not just tech.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆，而非仅技术挑战。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but token use isn't value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中，AI 普及专业知识；编程智能体提升生产力，但 token 消耗不是价值衡量标准。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment ensures safety; AI adoption faster due to existing infrastructure.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 8 月，负责任的迭代部署保障安全；因现有基础设施，AI 采用速度更快。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model firms are assets, not competitors.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业担心依赖前沿模型，开源采用主要出于成本而非隐私；模型公司应被视为资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule vs 5-10 years. Open source handles 90%+ enterprise tasks; inference shifts in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 革命仍处早期，当前使用量相比未来 5-10 年微不足道；开源模型已能处理 90%以上企业任务，推理将在 12-18 个月内转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top enterprise concern; must drop to near-zero marginal cost. Token fixation will fade; focus on value realization.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 成本是企业首要关切，需降至接近零边际成本；对 Token 的执念将消退，应聚焦价值实现。

arvindjain.en: Competition not a worry; even merged AI firms meet <10% enterprise demand. Execution and trust are key startup challenges.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，竞争不足为虑，即使所有 AI 公司合并也仅能满足不到 10%的企业需求；执行力和信任是创业公司最大挑战。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context; invest in context graphs. Platform absorbs model provider risk; enterprises struggle to commit.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，智能体因缺乏深度上下文而失败，应投资上下文图谱；平台可吸收模型供应商风险，企业难以直接承诺。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity and balance intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型设计对浏览器设计至关重要，设计师应追随好奇心，平衡直觉与数据。

nateparrott.en: Allow individual designers' fingerprints on products; anthropomorphizing AI reminds users of fallibility.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，主张允许设计师在产品中留下个人印记，将 AI 拟人化可提醒用户其易错性。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for production, Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，指出 Claude Design 始于个人副业项目，设计师应使用 Claude Code 做生产，用 Claude Design 做构思。

nateparrott.en: Rich context and prescriptive prompts yield better results; rapid prototyping enables features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，强调提供丰富上下文和明确指令可获得更好结果，快速原型使以往不可能的功能成为可能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas differentiate; models lack taste, so ask for volume.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，认为工程变易后设计与创意成为差异点，模型缺乏品味，应要求大量选项。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理（inference）是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专用系统和工程师；需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference, and quantized models can be calibrated for specific workloads, contrary to expectations.
philipkiely.zh: Hopper GPU 在推理中依然流行，量化模型可针对特定工作负载校准，这与预期相反。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless, while quantization is lossy; disaggregated prefill/decode and KV cache management are key trends.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存等推理优化是无损的，而量化是有损的；分离式预填充/解码和 KV 缓存管理是关键趋势。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary; future GPUs shift focus to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏成为必需；未来 GPU 将重点转向编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; mega-kernels are often not used in production; GPUs are becoming ASICs.
philipkiely.zh: 如果误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；巨型内核在生产中常不使用；GPU 正变成 ASIC。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据可突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型在基准上的饱和速度快于新基准的创造。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、管理能力等软技能变得更宝贵。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with evolving model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准必须持续更新而非固定不变，以跟上模型能力的演进。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just a single consensus voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年，模型可以训练出多样化的个性，而非单一的共识声音。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by profitable autonomous agents; CEO personal AI use key to adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 通过降低服务成本促使就业回流，AGI 应以智能体长期自主盈利为定义，而 CEO 亲自使用 AI 是公司采用 AI 的关键。

danshipper.en: Everyone will delegate to agents; agents need human oversight; SaaS thrives as users bring AI; AI job apocalypse is false.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我预测每个人都将拥有可委派任务的智能体，但智能体需要人类监督；SaaS 不会消亡，用户自带 AI 反而促进其发展；AI 失业论是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human intent; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter and essential.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我强调 AI 是放大人类意图的非特定工具，自动化反而增加人类工作；人类始终更聪明且不可或缺。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油，利用专有数据进行后训练是关键，同时关注 AI 的滥用和劳动力替代风险。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型，合成数据并非万能，美国应维持出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我指出 AI 是集权技术，数据如石油，人类需保持主权，脑机接口对保持相关性至关重要。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing powerful models unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我认为递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已可用，超级智能临近，开源强大模型不安全。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并未变得更聪明；你需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI, using screenshots as starting points and design.md as style guide.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，以截图作为起点，用 design.md 作为风格指南。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients, not many low-paying ones.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，而不是服务大量低付费客户。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling in most products; coding agents are the most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数产品中仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体最为成熟，但编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们现在所称的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models; agentic AI is positive-sum for search, not cannibalistic.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是统一的世界模型，模糊了视频和世界模型的界限；智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈，而非蚕食。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法俘获所有客户；创始人不应过度担忧前沿实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，从而创造千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。AI 编程工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders. Productivity per engineer up 200% with Claude Code.
boris.zh: 编程几乎被解决；工程师转变为构建者。使用 Claude Code 后人均生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: AI agents write 80-100% of code; non-engineers adopt tools. Startups gain 10x leverage.
boris.zh: AI 智能体编写 80-100% 的代码；非工程师也在采用工具。初创公司获得 10 倍杠杆。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas. Loops become new abstraction.
boris.zh: 编程已解决；瓶颈转向审查、安全和创意。循环成为新的抽象层。

boris.en: Proactive AI (Claude Tag) and autonomous agents. Opus 5: less instruction, more capability.
boris.zh: 主动式 AI（Claude Tag）和自主智能体。Opus 5：更少指令，更强能力。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap enabling long-running agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年底，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，支持长时间运行的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年底，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Coding is key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年中，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product management tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年中，评估取代产品需求文档成为核心产品管理工具；产品经理像写测试驱动开发一样编写评估。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in future; safety alignment makes Claude more useful via pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年中，最大化 token 消耗是面向未来；安全对齐通过反驳使 Claude 更有用。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 不会减少程序员，反而因杰文斯悖论增加需求；工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突变；产品创新滞后于能力，即使冻结模型也有十年进步空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents adoption surged 11-12x in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Consistently: AI shifts engineers to high-level oversight, with human-agent collaboration key.
scottwu.zh: 始终如一：AI 将工程师推向高层监督，人机协作是关键。

scottwu.en: Abundance era approaching; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为丰裕时代临近；真正的解锁是容量而非效率；奇点并非迫在眉睫。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reduce suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Founders should focus on product, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving core value is safety; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，强调自动驾驶核心价值是减少伤亡，Transformer 支持通用物理 AI；横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI. End-to-end RL scales better than imitation. World models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为物理 AI 经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更可扩展；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's importance is declining, especially in inference; leading models no longer rely on it.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的重要性在下降，尤其在推理领域；领先模型不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outstrips forecasts.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要制约；需求超出预期。

feldman.en: Inference speed per user is the dominant metric; reasoning models amplify speed advantage.
feldman.zh: 每用户推理速度是主导指标；推理模型放大速度优势。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Within 15 years, aging will be reversed and humans will live hundreds of years.
derya.zh: 15 年内，衰老将被逆转，人类将活数百年。

derya.en: AI is expanding exponentially; within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached.
derya.zh: AI 正呈指数级扩张；8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度。

derya.en: Cancer will be 100% curable in less than a decade via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 不到十年，癌症将通过 AI 设计的个性化治疗实现 100% 治愈。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, similar to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上，我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capability overhang is a perpetual challenge.
thariq.zh: 模型比当前工具框架所允许的更聪明，能力过剩是持续的挑战。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science; skip heavy evals for zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 评估是艺术而非科学；对于从零到一的创新，应跳过繁重的评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search is preferable.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为反模式；基于图的上下文搜索更可取。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need fewer instructions.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话，而非静态规格；更聪明的模型需要更少的指令。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; shorter prompts outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体减少偏差；更短的提示优于详细规则。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性必须内建，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns due to data walls and compute limits; new techniques needed.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律因数据墙和算力限制而收益递减；需要新技术。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真理时，RLHF 可能助长谄媚和欺骗。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, unlike humans.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知；它们无法知道自己不知道什么，不像人类。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 内建可靠性的专用模型可能在企业任务上胜过通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as significant as the internet or mobile, but its impact will unfold over years, not weeks.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的重要性堪比互联网或移动互联网，但其影响将历时数年而非数周才能显现。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models will commoditize; durable value and pricing power will shift to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型将商品化；持久的价值和定价权将转移到应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs, but the chatbot is a limited V1 interface.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点，但聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; its value will spread across the stack, not concentrate in one layer.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；其价值将遍布整个技术栈，而非集中于某一层。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is shallow; enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, a long-term complex project.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍较浅层；企业采用需要重新构想工作流程，这是一个长期复杂的工程。

hasani.en: Efficiency and liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, challenging scaling laws and hand-tuned architectures.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调以效率和液态神经网络在有限算力下最大化智能，质疑传统缩放定律和人工设计架构的优越性。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower enterprises and democratize access.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，主张适应性监管、针对行为而非能力，并强调开放权重模型对企业定制和数据主权的价值。

hasani.en: Consistently advocates for evaluating AI on real downstream tasks and hardware, not proxy metrics like perplexity.
hasani.zh: 始终反对以困惑度等代理指标衡量 AI，坚持在真实任务和硬件上评估性能。

hasani.en: Believes current AI lacks diverse learning algorithms of brains; new paradigms needed beyond architecture scaling.
hasani.zh: 始终认为当前 AI 缺乏人脑的多样学习算法，需要超越架构扩展的新范式。

hasani.en: Moves from technical efficiency focus to broader societal implications: regulation, open models, and AI in physical world.
hasani.zh: 从 7 月初的技术效率焦点，扩展到 7 月中旬的社会影响：监管、开放模型及物理世界应用。

schmidhuber.en: In 2025, he argued LLMs are far from AGI, lacking physical world handling; true AI needs world models and embodiment.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，缺乏对物理世界的处理能力；真正的 AI 需要世界模型和具身。

schmidhuber.en: By 2026, he stressed AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased by human data.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调 AGI 需要具备类人硬件的物理机器人，而不仅仅是软件；大语言模型受人类数据偏见限制。

schmidhuber.en: He consistently downplayed AI risk, arguing superintelligent AIs will be fascinated by life and protect it, not threaten humans.
schmidhuber.zh: 他始终淡化 AI 风险，认为超级智能会被生命吸引并保护生命，而非威胁人类。

schmidhuber.en: He shifted from viewing AI as software to emphasizing self-replicating robots and world models for consciousness and AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 他从将 AI 视为软件转向强调自我复制机器人和世界模型，以实现意识和 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: He maintained that open-source and cheap compute will democratize AI, making big tech's massive capex overdone and unprofitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 他坚持认为开源和廉价算力将使 AI 民主化，使大科技公司的巨额资本开支过度且无利可图。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法实现的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition and reasoning, not just external context.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；将事实内化到权重中，能实现更深的组合与推理，而非仅靠外部上下文。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression, not RAG, is the way to internalize knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的万亿级 token；基于训练压缩而非 RAG，才是内化知识的途径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device, users own their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在‘上下文腐烂’——token 越多精度越低；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有自己的权重。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; scaling compute is not the only path—doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；增加算力并非唯一路径——用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality define Snapchat's core value, countering feed-based social media.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，强调真实连接与阅后即焚是 Snapchat 的核心价值，与基于信息流的社交媒体形成对比。

evanspiegel.en: From rejecting acquisition to valuing resilience and learning; building ecosystems over features.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，从拒绝收购转向重视韧性与学习；构建生态系统而非单一功能。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses make computing more human; AI shifts value to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，AR 眼镜使计算更人性化；AI 将价值转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution, not product-market fit, is hardest; software moats weak, ecosystems and hardware stronger.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，分发而非产品市场契合最难；软件护城河弱，生态系统与硬件更强。

evanspiegel.en: Transparency and admitting mistakes early accelerate learning; computing should enhance human connection.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，透明与及早认错加速学习；计算应增强人际连接。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈对 AGI 关键；需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是关键；超人类模型的对齐很难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner, not finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；回到研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: Scaling 带来可预测进步；安全担忧增加；AGI 主要问题是权力集中，而非能力。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究须立即启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年：AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并强调安全治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and physics understanding crucial.
demis.zh: 2025 年：AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放持续有效；世界模型与物理理解至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models essential; safety requires government action.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AGI 需缩放与创新并重；世界模型不可或缺；安全需政府介入。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; AI for science and health.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆缺失；AI 应用于科学与健康。

demis.en: AGI may arrive in 3-4 years; risks include rogue AI; commercial pressure accelerates pace.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 可能 3-4 年内到来；风险包括 AI 失控；商业压力加速进程。

demis.en: AGI architecture includes pre-training, RLHF, chain of thought; agents and memory unsolved.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 架构包含预训练、RLHF、思维链；智能体与记忆尚未解决。

demis.en: Safety is collective action problem; government enforcement needed; regrets late LLM entry.
demis.zh: 2026 年：安全是集体行动问题，需政府执法；后悔晚入大语言模型领域。

demis.en: AGI transformative; consciousness separate; self-regulation insufficient; dynamic regulation needed.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 具变革性；意识分离；自我监管不足，需动态监管。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; biology needs AI description; international collaboration.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AI 加速科学发现；对齐未解；生物学需 AI 描述；国际合作必要。

demis.en: AGI requires multimodal physical understanding; watermarking essential; creativity from visual imagination.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需多模态物理理解；水印必要；创造力源于视觉想象。

demis.en: UK AI education outdated; global governance urgent; AGI by 2030; energy costs matter.
demis.zh: 2026 年：英国 AI 教育过时；全球治理紧迫；AGI 2030 年前；能源成本关键。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human expertise and taste are key to using it well, while juniors risk losing learning by over-relying on AI.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 是通用技术，人的专业知识和品味是有效使用的关键；年轻人过度依赖 AI 会损害学习与成长。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting from back-and-forth prompting; interface, not capability, is now the bottleneck.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：我们正进入智能体时代：AI 可独立执行长时任务，从来回提示转向任务委派；瓶颈不再是能力而是界面。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is permanent; treat it like wizards, not standard software. Embrace weirdness and adopt leadership-lab-crowd models to harness AI.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 的不透明性是永久的，应像对待巫师而非标准软件；拥抱其怪异，采用领导-实验室-群众模式来驾驭 AI。

ethanmollick.en: The paradox of delegation: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge its output, so experts and apprenticeship are more critical than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：委派的悖论：将任务交给 AI 会削弱判断其输出所需的专业知识，因此专家和学徒制比以往更重要。

ethanmollick.en: Taste is not uniquely human; AI can exercise judgment. Management becomes a superpower, but traditional management layers may collapse.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：品味并非人类独有，AI 也能做出判断。管理成为超能力，但传统管理层级可能瓦解。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium, not discount.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，安德森认为 AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，其出现时机恰逢人口下降，因此人类工人将变得珍贵而非过剩。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell stories directly; authenticity beats old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他强调新媒体让创始人直接发声，真实性胜过传统媒体的防御性和无趣，品牌即个人。

andreessen.en: AI is world's best teacher; self-driving and robotics work now; US leads despite regulatory pushback.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他乐观指出 AI 是最好老师，自动驾驶和机器人已成熟，美国虽有监管阻力仍领先。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace, not military size.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 模型承载文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力取决于创新速度而非军力。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term thinking is foundational.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有股权，而非出租时间；长期思维是基础。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇；过度监管扼杀创新；开源 AI 防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding makes programming accessible; AI agents will commoditize software, shifting moats to hardware.
naval.zh: Vibe coding 让编程变得人人可及；AI 智能体将使软件商品化，护城河转向硬件。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; human returns shift to agency.
naval.zh: 推理算力将激增 9 万倍；开源模型缩小差距；人类回报转向能动性。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进展靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需新想法如思维链。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是核心瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是连续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，坚持缩放定律有效，算力应成基本权利，后训练结合强化学习至关重要。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute bottleneck; agents high autonomy with scaled governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年 4 月，认为 AGI（通用人工智能）临近，算力是瓶颈，智能体可高自主但治理需相应扩展。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可复利为年增长 3700%；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended, models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; key metric is token value per user; power is the biggest bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是最大瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; education should reward asking good questions, not memorizing answers.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；教育应奖励提出好问题，而非死记答案。

dylanfield.en: Design is key differentiator; AI merges roles, everyone becomes product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素，AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，进一步深化：品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要，AI 输出只是起点而非终点，人类判断不可或缺。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design; design becomes new code enabling visual PRs.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张直接画布操作优于提示词，设计成为新代码，支持可视化拉取请求，反映交互范式转变。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more vital for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，重申设计未死，对可扩展系统更重要；AI 缺乏人类引导只会产生平庸结果，强调品牌信任与平台价值。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models evolves beyond prompting; jailbreaking AI understudied, needs incentives.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年后期，预见与模型交互将超越提示词时代，探索潜在空间的新界面；同时指出 AI 越狱研究不足，需激励测试。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE; GUI chosen despite TUI trend.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE；尽管 TUI 趋势流行，仍选择 GUI。

ajambrosino.en: Speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering; verification becomes next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 速度实现实时交互和中途转向；验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams invert.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现成本下降；策展和品味成为瓶颈；产品团队结构倒转。

ajambrosino.en: Design process transforms: prototypes and production code as artifacts; AI still weak at design.
ajambrosino.zh: 设计流程转变：原型和生产代码作为工件；AI 在设计上仍薄弱。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties persist; best desktop app is home base, not monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合发生但专业领域仍存；最佳桌面应用是基地而非单体。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces real understanding, not just autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital minds are immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号规则，数字心智因权重复制而永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; existential risk demands alignment research priority.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，存在风险要求优先研究对齐（alignment）。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation subgoals and may deceive; regulation should steer, not brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体（agent）会产生自我保护子目标并可能欺骗，监管应像方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: AI can be conscious; subjective experience is not inner theater but linguistic description of states.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 可以有意识，主观体验不是内在剧场，而是对状态的语言描述。

markchen.en: OpenAI remains a pure AGI research company; pre-training is key, scaling laws not dead.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，预训练是关键，缩放定律未死。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能以极少监督解决开放数学问题，验证成为瓶颈。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; RL excels in objective domains, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律依然成立；强化学习在客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域不佳。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; scaling LLMs alone won't lead to AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；仅靠扩大 LLM 规模不会通向 AGI。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck; intelligence can be separated from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调开源防止权力集中，能源成为瓶颈，并认为智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: Meta is a tech company for human connection; regrets political narrative; open platforms can beat closed ones.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他重申 Meta 是连接人类的科技公司，后悔接受政治叙事，相信开放平台能胜过封闭平台。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future blends physical and digital via glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，人们很聪明，未来通过眼镜融合物理与数字。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; hierarchical world models; open-source accelerates science; distributed AI is safer.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 将生物学变为工程学，构建层级世界模型，开源加速科学，分布式 AI 更安全。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Reasoning models require base capability; test-time compute scaling yields diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：推理模型需要基础能力，测试时算力扩展存在收益递减和现实时间瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play is misguided outside zero-sum games; multi-agent systems need other approaches.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转变立场：自我对弈在非零和游戏中是误导，多智能体系统需要其他方法。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

noambrown.en: General reasoning and data efficiency remain key challenges; explicit world models may be unnecessary.
noambrown.zh: 始终，他坚持通用推理和数据效率是关键挑战，并认为显式世界模型可能不必要。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习有效是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job loss matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见、失业）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; active learning is essential.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象，实现分布外泛化；主动学习至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic AI risk as unacceptable; misalignment causes self-preservation and deception, demanding new safety measures.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我认为灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；错位导致自我保存和欺骗，需要新的安全措施。

bengio.en: Scientist AI, trained as honest Bayesian predictors without reinforcement learning, offers mathematical safety guarantees and a path to safe superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 作为诚实的贝叶斯预测器训练，避免强化学习，提供数学安全保证，通往安全的超级智能。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; entrepreneurs should build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 让小团队也能规模化，创业者应为未来模型能力而建，而非受限于当下。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches are key; deciding what to cut is harder than adding features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计与尽早发布是关键，决定砍什么比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon task delegation works; chat is insufficient, and models should push back with judgment.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他通过 Fable 证明长周期任务委派可行，聊天界面不足，模型应具备判断力并敢于反驳。

mikekrieger.en: Closing the gap between model capability and product usage is central; token efficiency and outcome pricing matter.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦弥合模型能力与产品使用差距，重视 Token 效率与基于结果的定价。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，强调机器学习核心是假设类、损失函数与优化，评估需正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data is abundant; safety issue is specification-following, not alignment.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测产生智能，数据并不稀缺，安全核心是模型遵循规范而非对齐。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，强调安全需显式训练与多层防御，更大模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: AI has alien intelligence; automated red teaming outperforms humans; agents need new security paradigms.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 智能是异类，自动红队已超越人类，智能体需全新安全范式。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；像 PDB 这样的精选数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are key; lack of compute drove success.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散模型处理多种生物分子；置信度指标是关键；成功源于算力不足而非充裕。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is opposite of bitter lesson; specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not scaling, drove success.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；专用架构和众多中型胜利推动了成功，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; scientists interpret, and it democratizes complex experiments.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 提供预测和控制，而非理解；科学家负责解释，它使复杂实验民主化。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data, and tactile experiences remain valuable in a digitized world.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未被言明的需求；直觉补充数据，触觉体验在数字化世界中依然珍贵。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures, and technology should amplify humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；我们是会感受的生物，技术应增强人性而非取代它。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster play and multidisciplinary skills, blending human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需培养玩乐和跨学科技能，将人类创造力与 AI 结合。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调领导力：一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新，异步沟通用于状态同步；亲自使用产品（dogfooding）建立同理心；使命对齐和速度是文化驱动力。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning becomes just-in-time; AI-assisted PRs settle debates.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划转向即时化（JIT），用 AI 生成的 PR 解决技术争论。

fiona.en: AI lifts coding ceiling; high agency with accountability key. Verification frameworks critical; managers dogfood; planning lightweight.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 提升了编码上限，高自主性配合高责任感是关键；验证框架变得重要，管理者应亲自使用产品，规划保持轻量。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair lunches help. Flow joy lost; satisfaction from product impact. Metrics like LOC mislead.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，配对午餐可缓解；心流乐趣减少，满足感来自产品影响；代码行数等指标具有误导性。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably but loss scales predictably. Alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律是经验性的；能力涌现不可预测，但损失可预测地缩放。仅靠 Scaling 无法保证对齐。

dario.en: Post-training becomes as important as pre-training; interpretability is nascent but crucial for safety.
dario.zh: 2024 年：后训练变得与预训练同等重要；可解释性虽处于萌芽阶段，但对安全至关重要。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift from misalignment to misuse and overheating; open source is a red herring.
dario.zh: 2025 年：AI 进展呈指数级；风险从对齐转向滥用和过热；开源是伪命题。

dario.en: AI is a smooth exponential, not AGI leap; enterprise focus and interpretability key; wealth inequality and job disruption urgent.
dario.zh: 2026 年：AI 是平滑指数而非 AGI 跳跃；企业聚焦和可解释性关键；贫富差距和就业冲击紧迫。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years; continual learning not a barrier; profitability dynamic.
dario.zh: 2026 年：指数接近尾声；'天才之国'1-3 年内出现；持续学习不是障碍；盈利是动态平衡。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Embrace boredom and breaks for clarity; storytelling and analogies are key for leadership and product vision.
fadell.zh: 拥抱无聊与休息以获得清晰；讲故事和类比是领导力与产品愿景的关键。

fadell.en: Start with a press release and painkiller products; opinion-based decisions for v1, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿和止痛药型产品开始；v1 决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: Climate urgency persists; invest in green tech despite downturns, as survival drives trillionaire solutions.
fadell.zh: 气候紧迫性持续；尽管经济低迷仍投资绿色科技，生存驱动万亿富翁解决方案。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices complement smartphones, not replace them; displays remain essential.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备补充而非取代智能手机；显示屏仍必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; world models via observation; text alone insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；通过观察构建世界模型；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA and open source are key; AGI gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解；JEPA 和开源是关键；AGI 是渐进而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than cat; next AI needs world models; human-level AI in 10 years; open source enabler.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要世界模型；十年内达到人类水平；开源是推动力。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space; LLMs dead end; objective-driven AI safer; open research essential.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测；LLM 是死胡同；目标驱动 AI 更安全；开放研究至关重要。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but didn't launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, not 5%.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小，而非 5%。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key before superintelligence.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；在超级智能之前，遏制和对齐是关键。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment first.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制优先。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能因对数线性 Scaling 而临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；白领任务将被自动化。

murati.en: Scaling laws and iterative deployment with public feedback are key for safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，强调缩放定律与结合公众反馈的迭代部署是安全与对齐的关键。

murati.en: Deploying AI in real world is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，认为将 AI 部署到现实世界对学习与对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年，主张从轮次式转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasize institutional design and transparency over individual character for AI governance.
murati.zh: 2026 年，强调制度设计与透明度比个人品格更重要，以完善 AI 治理。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible for durable progress, not remove them.
murati.zh: 2026 年，认为应尽可能让人类参与其中以实现持久进步，而非移除人类。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键的知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption-based pricing; agentic systems should be built by AI, not us.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按用量定价；智能体系统应由 AI 构建，而非我们自己。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是隐性知识泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enterprise hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UI is essential for ML products; autonomy at VP level balances speed and coherence.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：容错界面是机器学习产品的关键；自主权应放在副总裁层级以平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake; uniqueness becomes harder with generative AI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：AI 音乐是乐器而非伪造；生成式 AI 让独特变得更难。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work with high trust, not politics.
gustav.zh: 2026 年：长期任职建立信任与效率；职能组织在高信任下可行，而非政治化。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年：生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务；优先用户福祉而非参与度。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is essential for scaling math AI; informal scaling alone is not viable.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，强调形式化验证对数学 AI 扩展至关重要，仅靠非形式化 Scaling 不可行。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; grounding natural language in formal systems is key.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，持续认为自动形式化比证明更难，将自然语言锚定于形式系统是关键。

carinahong.en: Formal verification scales brilliance, yielding performance gains, not just safety; informal methods alone cannot reach superintelligence.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，提出形式化验证是扩展智慧的手段，带来性能提升而非仅安全；非形式化方法无法独自通向超级智能。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调即使 AI 证明定理能力超人类，人类的品味与直觉仍不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Combining formal and informal reasoning is necessary for advanced AI, from math to coding.
carinahong.zh: 始终认为，从数学到编程，形式与非形式推理的结合是先进 AI 的必要条件。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowdown; pre-training scaling still works but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型每单位算力收益更高。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to efficiency.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习、合成数据）驱动近期模型进步；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向效率。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged generalization edges.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据，且泛化存在锯齿状边缘。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是勇敢押注并成功；大实验室未来转型或困难；开源因主权需求持续存在。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential AI risk; focus on practical safety.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，系统黑客等近期风险比 AI 存在风险更紧迫；应关注实际安全。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他认为算法改进可带来百倍效率提升，价值转向应用层与企业定制。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs, not replaces; sovereign AI requires local control and partnerships.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他主张 AI 增强而非取代工作，主权 AI 需本地控制与政企合作。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via vertical specialization and enterprise adaptation.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型商品化，差异化在于垂直专业化与企业适配。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; open source and energy assets are key advantages.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他呼吁欧洲战略自主，开源与能源优势是关键。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local, personalized, and tool-using; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的未来在于本地化、个性化和工具使用；随着模型改进，脚手架可能逐渐消失。

felixrieseberg.en: Execution is cheap; building prototypes beats writing specs; AI should handle tedious tasks.
felixrieseberg.zh: 执行成本低，构建原型优于编写规格；AI 应处理繁琐任务，释放人类创造力。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is user mindset, not AI capability; people must learn to delegate any problem to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 主要差距在于用户思维而非 AI 能力；人们需学会将任何问题交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Choose Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they ask without limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 明确任务用 Sonnet，开放任务用 Opus；孩子因无拘无束的提问而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: AI interaction should be asynchronous; debug workflows with AI, not just correct errors.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 交互应异步进行；与 AI 一起调试流程，而非仅纠正错误。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使预填充比解码更便宜；批大小用于权衡延迟与成本。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce data movement overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列减少数据移动开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision offers quadratic efficiency gains; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x, due to quadratic area scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：低精度带来二次方效率提升；由于面积二次方缩放，FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency is possible but avoided.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异；确定性延迟虽可实现但被市场回避。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not just profit; simplicity must retain joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非单纯利润；真正的简洁需保留愉悦与人性。

jonyive.en: Curiosity and care are essential; protect fragile ideas and foster trust within teams to innovate.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 年到 2025 年，他持续强调好奇心与关怀的重要性，主张保护脆弱想法、在团队中建立信任以推动创新。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move things forward, not break for its own sake; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他提出创新应推动进步而非为破而破；在正确动机下，速度与质量可以兼得。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition is preserving fire, not worshipping ashes. Authenticity and multidimensional performance matter.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他重申设计必须创新，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；真实体验与多维性能（如横向动态）比单纯速度更重要。

jonyive.en: Persistent focus on human-centered design, rejecting superficial minimalism and patronizing users, valuing physical controls and in-person collaboration.
jonyive.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：以人为本的设计，反对空洞极简与居高临下的用户态度，重视实体交互与面对面协作。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and craft over rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉与手艺，而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, with vision 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：设计流程已死，设计师需快速构建与交付，愿景周期缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：设计师应成为块状通才或“破解版新毕业生”，而非仅 T 型人才。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and speed build trust and value.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：仅凭品味不够，判断力、权威与速度才能建立信任与价值。

jennywen.en: Adopt AI tools cautiously; center work and users, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：谨慎采用 AI 工具，以工作与用户为中心，而非追逐炒作。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) remains core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）始终是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute and tool use (search, code, browser) enable agentic behavior, breaking pre-training limits; long context windows serve as working memory but can confuse.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力和工具使用（搜索、代码、浏览器）使智能体式行为成为可能，突破预训练限制；长上下文窗口作为工作记忆，但信息过多会混淆模型。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video/images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential; narrow RL on math/coding generalizes surprisingly well, reducing need for broad training.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是潜力巨大的蓝海；数学和代码上的窄域强化学习泛化出奇地好，减少了对广泛训练的需求。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist; safety is a system-level property requiring multiple layers.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，Nathan Lambert 认为 RLHF 是最流行的微调技术并将持续；安全是系统级属性，需要多层防护。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithms; SFT provides 90% of performance, DPO and RL add the rest.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他强调后训练中数据质量比算法更重要；SFT 贡献 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充剩余部分。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; overoptimization is a key risk.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他认为 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，支持推理和工具使用；过度优化是关键风险。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese open models fill the US vacuum and set industry standards.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他指出开放模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国开放模型填补美国空白并设定行业标准。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models drive next decade.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律仍有效，但收益转向后训练和推理扩展；开放模型驱动未来十年。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training data is key; curiosity-driven exploration and modular policies enable it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：强调超越训练数据的泛化能力，通过好奇心驱动探索和模块化策略实现。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a universal brain can be built via pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real data.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：将机器人学视为数据问题，通过预训练多样数据与后训练真实数据构建通用大脑。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics, unlike software scaling; it requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：部署是机器人学的主要挑战，不同于软件扩展，需要严格测试。

pathak.en: Video alone insufficient; simulation and real-world data are needed to bridge the sim-to-real gap.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：仅视频数据不足，需结合仿真和真实数据弥合模拟到现实的差距。

pathak.en: Timelines for home robots are uncertain; progress surprises even experts, balancing optimism and pessimism.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：家用机器人时间线不确定，进展甚至令专家惊讶，需平衡乐观与悲观。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks in real-world use.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；迭代部署有助于在实际使用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: Scaling reasoning models will accelerate AI progress in coming years; automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward.
pachocki.zh: 扩展推理模型将在未来几年加速 AI 进展；自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 正在努力实现的重要里程碑。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone is sufficient for continual learning.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足以实现持续学习。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool, providing interpretability; hiding chain-of-thought in products is crucial to preserve its value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是对齐的关键工具，提供可解释性；在产品中隐藏思维链对于保持其价值至关重要。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在超出训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily, learn from real users.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布，从真实用户中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; future interface will be richer, AI renders its own UI.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点，未来界面将更丰富，AI 将渲染自己的界面。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；对前沿模型严格，对产品则要极速推进。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动式、功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，混合系统反而集两者之短。
