kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，强调世界模型带来推理与涌现安全行为，如盲弯前探。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，认为纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需雷达与激光雷达。

kendall.en: AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，展望 AV 3.0 通过网状网络将智能移出车外，取消红绿灯。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem solved with end-to-end learning; scaling is key.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，重申自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题，端到端学习与 Scaling（规模扩张）是关键。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，提出零样本泛化可覆盖 500+城市，无需预先训练数据。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，认为消费级车辆在中短期将超越 Robotaxi 规模。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，强调基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kohli.en: AI in science should tackle root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应解决根本性问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为大语言模型的幻觉若与真值检测器结合，可激发创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 始终，我认为可验证领域（如代码）对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not suffice; new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上，因为从 80% 到 99.9% 的性能提升极其困难。仅靠 LLM 可能不够，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluation with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进步需要由老练且有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools can hallucinate; human judgment is critical. Anchoring and sycophancy may cause doctors to underperform AI alone.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 工具可能产生幻觉，人类判断至关重要。锚定效应和谄媚可能导致医生表现不如单独使用 AI。

edwinchen.en: AI in medicine must prioritize safety over accuracy; omission—failing to recommend important actions—is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 医学中的 AI 必须将安全置于准确性之上；遗漏（未能推荐重要措施）是主要风险。

edwinchen.en: Quality data creation requires taste and sophistication; different labs' objective functions will shape diverse AIs, not one model to rule all.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据创建需要品味和成熟度；不同实验室的目标函数将塑造多样化的 AI，而非一个模型统治一切。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on a higher purpose; survival is core, and hardware is easier than software due to distribution challenges.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，Carl Pei 强调品牌建设需围绕更高使命凝聚团队，生存是核心；同时认为硬件比软件容易，因为软件分发更难。

carlpei.en: Smartphones' future lies in generative UI and proactive agents; AI models will commoditize, and hardware margins are low, so evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，Carl Pei 认为手机未来在于生成式界面和主动式智能体；AI 模型将商品化，硬件利润率低，需超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI is mostly BS; focus on applied AI solving real pain points. LLMs commoditize, open-source matches commercial, leading to price wars.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Carl Pei 批评多数 AI 无实际价值，强调应用型 AI 解决真实痛点；大语言模型商品化，开源追平商业，引发价格战。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature categories; AI is an ingredient, not a hype. Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses, only brain-computer interfaces.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，Carl Pei 认为在成熟品类中设计是差异化关键；AI 是成分而非噱头。手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口可能。

carlpei.en: Apps will disappear; agents execute intent. Privacy demands local or hybrid compute. Mid-range phones deserve A-team, not annual flagships.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，Carl Pei 预言应用将消失，智能体按意图执行；隐私要求本地或混合算力。中端手机应获精英团队，旗舰不必每年更新。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应增强人类能力；从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有前途路径。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues and contribute uniquely.
nando.zh: AI 安全是最大的开放挑战；非洲可以跨越遗留问题并做出独特贡献。

nando.en: Emphasis shifted from scaling and generalist agents to responsible deployment and safety concerns.
nando.zh: 重点从规模扩张和通用智能体转向负责任部署和安全问题。

nando.en: AI should serve humanity broadly, including education and solving global problems.
nando.zh: AI 应广泛服务于人类，包括教育和解决全球问题。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for building beneficial AI.
nando.zh: 多样性和包容性对于构建有益的 AI 至关重要。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，我认为具身对 AI 知识落地和减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 因缺乏具身经验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems with language as interface, tools as software, and vector databases as hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，我将 LLM 比作操作系统，语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, while LLMs handle high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，我认为强化学习最适合底层控制，而 LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，我强调机器人学的瓶颈是数据问题，仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是未来。

jimfan.en: The physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，我提出物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱房间——是具身 AI 的重大挑战。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence and solving onboarding.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能并解决上手问题。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL likely suffices for AGI, with coding as leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，编程是领先指标。

sholto.en: Agents' bar is reliability, not capability; longer agentic coherence (30h) expands achievements; RL is new scaling axis.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力；更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）能大幅扩展成就；强化学习是新的扩展轴。

sholto.en: Capability overhang exists; orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; compute is new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我指出存在能力过剩；编排和工具比原始智能更重要；算力是新石油。

sholto.en: Coding is most tractable due to verifiability; alignment research promising; transformers sufficient for AGI.
sholto.zh: 始终，我认为编程因可验证性而最易处理；对齐研究有前景；Transformer 足以实现 AGI。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题；数据与算法更优的小模型可在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 2023 年至 2025 年，我强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不足，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等后训练对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我认为数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be applied during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张强化学习不仅用于后训练，也可在预训练阶段应用，以奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing internet data is impossible.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我提出多元对齐以尊重人类多样价值观；互联网数据去偏不可行，多元对齐更佳。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation in interaction design.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；强调速度与熟悉感，而非交互设计上的创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic, not static.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，将设计提升为战略武器，强调创始人需阐明设计如何助力取胜，并尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness trump perfection; avoid structured design crits, prefer organic feedback to stay fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，坚持速度与决断优于完美；避免结构化设计评审，采用有机反馈以保持敏捷。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes and self-learning interns; adapt process to problem; gut decisions often beat data in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型和自学型实习生；流程应适应问题；在快节奏初创中，直觉常胜于数据。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute may surpass pre-training scaling as next driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年 10 月：缩放定律预测进展；测试时算力可能超越预训练缩放成为下一驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年 10 月：自然语言不会是主要编程方式；示例和直接操作更好。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; humans stay in driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025 年 5 月：编程从代码转向意图描述；人类保持主导。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment involves custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年 5 月：定制模型对产品质量至关重要；每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年 5 月：AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码为最终真相。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图而非流程；副业项目可超越传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用如同忽视早期互联网。

shazeer.en: Initially, LLMs are alchemy; scaling with compute and data improves them, but their inner workings remain mysterious.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型如同炼金术，扩大算力与数据能提升性能，但其内部机制仍属未知。

shazeer.en: By 2025, he emphasizes inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows as key near-term levers for capability gains.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年，他转而强调推理时算力扩展与更长上下文窗口是近期提升能力的关键杠杆。

shazeer.en: He shifts from passive data learning to advocating world interaction and continual modular learning for future models.
shazeer.zh: 他不再满足于被动数据学习，转而倡导模型通过世界互动与模块化持续学习来进化。

shazeer.en: He argues test-time compute scaling alone won't yield AGI; agentic action and RL are crucial, and open-source closes gap.
shazeer.zh: 他认为仅靠测试时算力扩展无法实现 AGI，智能体行为与强化学习至关重要，且开源正缩小差距。

shazeer.en: He maintains AGI's economic impact is underhyped, with coding as a self-accelerating force, and AI can generate novel ideas.
shazeer.zh: 他坚持 AGI 的经济影响被低估，编码是自我加速的动力，且 AI 能产生真正的新颖想法。

leike.en: AI safety research is under-explored; empirical work and skill-building matter more than capability fears.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全研究尚待深入，实证研究与技能积累比担忧能力研究更重要。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; scalable oversight and interpretability are key to aligning superintelligence.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展；可扩展监督与可解释性是实现超级智能对齐的关键。

leike.en: Alignment may be easier than thought; evaluation is easier than generation; train deceptive models as testbeds.
leike.zh: 2023 年：对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成简单；可故意训练欺骗性模型作为研究对象。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; external oversight and third-party testing needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化滑坡；仅靠后训练不足；需要外部监管与第三方测试。

leike.en: Even if alignment fails, raising misuse cost via techniques like Sophon may buy time; doomerism is defeatism.
leike.zh: 2024 年：即便对齐失败，通过类似 Sophon 的技术提高滥用成本可争取时间；悲观主义是失败主义。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are powerful signals for robot learning; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，Abbeel 强调自对弈和模仿学习为机器人学习提供强信号，并指出强化学习需层级推理以解决长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL improves sample efficiency; hard-coding prior knowledge is limiting; language models transfer to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，反对硬编码先验知识，并发现语言模型可迁移至非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics needs 99.9% reliability; single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出仓储机器人需达到 99.9%可靠性，且单一神经网络可泛化于不同任务和末端执行器。

abbeel.en: Consistent focus on RL and robotics, leveraging learning signals and transfer, while cautioning against hard-coded assumptions.
abbeel.zh: 始终关注强化学习与机器人学，善用学习信号与迁移，同时警惕硬编码假设的局限。
